messages:
sophia: Quick sync — proposing a compact qprofile bundle format for Redwood Optimize recommendations. goal: single artifact teams can consume for deploy + CI + Optimize UI. want to lock on minimal manifest fields, naming + versioning, and rollout metadata.
ryan: +1. can we do semver-ish but model-scoped? e.g. qprof://<model>:<arch>@vMAJOR.MINOR
ryan: minimal fields I care about: model_checksum, quant_backend (AWQ/GPTQ/INT8/FP8), bitwidth, quant_config_id, eval_snapshot_id, estimated_tokens_per_usd
li: add smoke_prompt_set and smoke_metrics (top-level) — CI needs quick pass/fail. suggest "delta_thresholds": {"exact_match": 0.01, "rouge_l": 0.02, "mlm_ppl": 0.03} (numbers as examples)
li: include a short example harness script path + container image tag so infra can run tests deterministically.
anita: for rollout we should include: canary_pct, fallback_model (string), compat_flags (list), min_throughput, max_latency_ms. also a release_notes_url and contact_owner.
anita: CI gating rule: if any smoke_metric delta > threshold -> block auto-rollout and create ticket with traces.
sophia: rough manifest sketch I put together:
```json
{
  "schema_version": "qprof-v1",
  "name": "qprof://gptx-large:rtx6000@v1.0",
  "model_checksum": "sha256:abcd...",
  "quant_backend": "awq",
  "bitwidth": "8",
  "quant_recipe": "awq-fp8-cal-2026-03",
  "eval_snapshot_id": "snap-20260305-1112",
  "smoke_prompt_set": "smoke/basic-qc-v3",
  "smoke_metrics": {"exact_match": 0.005, "ppl": 0.02},
  "delta_thresholds": {"exact_match": 0.01},
  "estimated_tokens_per_usd": 12500,
  "rollout": {"canary_pct": 5, "fallback_model": "gptx-large-int8-v0.9", "min_throughput": 50}
}
```
ryan: love the manifest. one note: "name" should be stable and human readable; manifest should also emit a consumer_compat list e.g. ["llm-infer-v2", "optimize-agent-1"]. helps runtime decide fallback.
li: please include a small deterministic seeds file + tokenizer_version in the manifest. quant randomness bite us before.
anita: operational playbook line for Optimize console: show estimated cost delta vs baseline, expected latency change, and a "regression risk" score. add link to per-prompt failure examples.
sophia: question for the group — should packaging be a single json file + tarball that contains: manifest.json, smoke_harness.sh, seeds.txt, eval_outputs/*.json, provenance.txt ?
ryan: yes tarball makes sense. name it like qprof-<model>-<arch>-vMAJ.MIN.tgz. include a signed manifest (kms-sig) so Private deployments can verify.
li: and add a small sanity test that does a prefix KV cache replay to ensure kv-cache sequencing unchanged between fp and quant.
anita: for CI: create two gates — quick smoke (minutes) and full validation (hours). quick smoke runs on PR, full validation on release tag. full val must run canonical eval set and compute per-task deltas.
opt-bot: SUMMARY (auto): created ticket RN-4823 to track qprofile bundle spec + CI gates. ACTIONS: sophia to iterate manifest w/ consumer_compat + tokenizer_version; ryan to draft signing/uri scheme; li to add smoke harness template; anita to write gating rules for Optimize. ETA initial PR: 1716660000 (~tomorrow).
ryan: one last: adopt a "compat_version" field that increments when we change what consumers expect. keep schema_version stable for small opt meta changes.
sophia: thanks all. I’ll push a draft spec PR tonight with examples for AWQ + GPTQ + INT8 and a tiny docker runner. ping me if you want to pair on the harness.
